power_observation_operator: weighted served interval energy / weighted counterfactual requested interval energy
transport_observation_operator: min(1, weighted completed OD trips / weighted counterfactual requested OD trips)
common_validation_clock: Delta_val >= max(native power interval, native transport interval); no false upsampling
u_obs_definition: Q95(abs(reconstructed service - reference service)) after measurement+inference+temporal uncertainty propagation
